system: Hall and Van de Castle content indicators

units.percent: values are percentages from 0 to 100, as published
units.ratio: values are ratios (interactions per character), as published

norms_page.citation: Schneider, A., and Domhoff, G. W. 'Dreams: Summary of Normative Findings', table 'Normative Expectations on All Major Indicators for the Main Content Categories in the Hall/Van de Castle System'. dreamresearch.net (the DreamBank site, hosted at dreams.ucsc.edu). Norms of Hall and Van de Castle (1966).
norms_page.used_for: men, women and combined values of every indicator except family_pct, dead_imaginary_pct and self_negativity_pct, which this table does not list

domhoff2005.citation: Domhoff, G. W. (2005). The dreams of men and women: Patterns of gender similarity and difference. dreamresearch.net, Table 3 'Female Norms vs. Male Norms on various Hall/Van de Castle content indicators'.
domhoff2005.used_for: family_pct, dead_imaginary_pct and self_negativity_pct; its values for the other indicators are listed under 'alt' where they differ from the norms page

domhoff1996.citation: Domhoff, G. W. (1996). Finding Meaning in Dreams: A Quantitative Approach. New York: Plenum. Chapter 2 (the coding system) and Chapter 4 (normative findings).
domhoff1996.used_for: cross-check of the norms page values (Tables 4.1 to 4.6 and text), definitions of the percents, and the note that about 100 dream reports are needed to approximate the norms

hall_vdc1966.citation: Hall, C. S., and Van de Castle, R. L. (1966). The Content Analysis of Dreams. New York: Appleton-Century-Crofts.
hall_vdc1966.used_for: the coding rules (characters, social interactions, striving, misfortunes and good fortunes, emotions, settings, objects) as posted on dreamresearch.net

dreamsat.citation: Schneider, A. (2001). DreamSAT: Automated Dream Data Entry System and Statistical Analysis Tool, documentation.
dreamsat.used_for: the h statistic for percentages and the rule that the A/C, F/C and S/C indexes are compared as 2.36 times the difference instead of h

fogli2020.citation: Fogli, A., Aiello, L. M., and Quercia, D. (2020). Our dreams, our selves: automatic analysis of dream reports. Royal Society Open Science, 7(8), 192080. https://doi.org/10.1098/rsos.192080
fogli2020.used_for: the formula of the dead and imaginary percent ((dead + fictional characters) / all characters), which the Domhoff pages read give as a value without a formula

comparison.percent: Cohen's h = 2 asin(sqrt(p_user)) minus 2 asin(sqrt(p_norm)), p as proportions from 0 to 1; positive means the user is higher than the norm. DreamSAT computes the same quantity as acos(1 minus 2p) for each proportion, then subtracts.
comparison.ratio: A/C, F/C and S/C are not proportions, so DreamSAT does not use h for them: it uses (user minus norm) times 2.36 'to bring the numbers into the same range you'd expect from the h statistic' (2.36, or 3 pi / 4, from randomization studies). This reproduces the h column of Domhoff (2005) Table 3 for these indexes.
comparison.both: For sex 'both' the norm is the simple mean of the men and women values (app choice). The norms page also publishes a combined column for 991 dream reports, kept here as 'combined' for reference.
comparison.summary_threshold: Observations are shown only when the absolute value of h is at least 0.2, Cohen's conventional lower bound for a small effect size (Cohen, 1977, the source Domhoff 1996 cites for h). The app also requires a denominator of at least 5 for an observation (app choice, not part of the published method).
comparison.reliability: Domhoff (1996, chapter 4) reports that it takes about 100 dream reports to approximate the norms. The app shows the profile from 10 coded dreams, labelled as an automatic estimate that becomes steadier with more dreams.

indicators.description_en: Of the characters whose sex is clear, the share who are men.
indicators.description_it: Tra i personaggi di cui è chiaro il sesso, la quota di uomini.
indicators.formula: male characters / (male characters + female characters); human characters only (individuals and single-sex groups); joint (mixed) and indefinite sex excluded; animals and creatures are not coded for sex
indicators.notes: Domhoff (1996) Table 4.1: men 587 male and 286 female characters (67%), women 507 and 547 (48%).

indicators.description_en: The share of human characters the dreamer knows personally or by reputation, such as family, friends or well-known people.
indicators.description_it: La quota di personaggi umani che chi sogna conosce di persona o di fama, come familiari, amici o persone note.
indicators.formula: familiar characters / (familiar + unfamiliar characters); familiar = family, relative, known, prominent; unfamiliar = occupational, ethnic, stranger, uncertain; human characters only
indicators.notes: The split of identity classes is inferred, not stated as a list: in Domhoff (1996) Table 4.1 familiar plus unfamiliar equals all human characters (men 501 + 607 = 1108, women 796 + 567 = 1363), so every identity class falls in one group, and the coding rules describe prominent characters as 'usually familiar because of their reputation'.

indicators.description_en: The share of human characters who are friends or acquaintances of the dreamer.
indicators.description_it: La quota di personaggi umani che sono amici o conoscenti di chi sogna.
indicators.formula: known characters / all human characters
indicators.notes: Domhoff (1996, chapter 2): 'Friends Percent = known characters / all human characters'.

indicators.description_en: The share of human characters who are family members or other relatives.
indicators.description_it: La quota di personaggi umani che sono familiari o altri parenti.
indicators.formula: (family + relative characters) / all human characters
indicators.notes: Not on the norms page table; value from Domhoff (2005) Table 3. Formula from the norms explanation page.

indicators.description_en: The share of characters who had already died, or who are imaginary or fictional figures.
indicators.description_it: La quota di personaggi già scomparsi, oppure immaginari o di finzione.
indicators.formula: (dead + imaginary characters) / all characters
indicators.notes: Value from Domhoff (2005) Table 3, printed as 00% and 01% (rounded). The Domhoff pages read give no formula; the formula follows Fogli et al. (2020) Table 1. The app's coding keeps one flag, dead_or_imaginary, so dead and imaginary are counted together, which is all this indicator needs. Because the norms are close to zero, a few such characters give a large h.

indicators.description_en: The share of all characters who are animals.
indicators.description_it: La quota di animali tra tutti i personaggi.
indicators.formula: animal characters / all characters (humans, animals and creatures)
indicators.notes: Domhoff (1996) Table 4.1: men 71 of 1180 characters, women 60 of 1423.

indicators.description_en: Of the dreamer's own encounters that are either hostile or friendly, the share that are hostile.
indicators.description_it: Tra gli incontri di chi sogna che sono ostili o amichevoli, la quota di quelli ostili.
indicators.formula: dreamer-involved aggressions / (dreamer-involved aggressions + dreamer-involved friendly interactions)
indicators.notes: Dreamer-involved means the dreamer is the initiator or the recipient.

indicators.description_en: In friendly encounters involving the dreamer, how often the dreamer is the one who starts them.
indicators.description_it: Negli incontri amichevoli che coinvolgono chi sogna, quanto spesso è chi sogna a prendere l'iniziativa.
indicators.formula: dreamer as befriender / (dreamer as befriender + dreamer as befriended); reciprocal, mutual, self-directed and witnessed friendliness excluded
indicators.notes: Domhoff (1996): 'The befriender percent does not include reciprocal and mutual friendly interactions.' The 1996 chapter 4 text gives 47 for women; the norms page gives 49. The app's coding has no separate mutual flag: mutual interactions are coded as reciprocal, and both are excluded here.

indicators.description_en: In hostile encounters involving the dreamer, how often the dreamer is the one who starts them.
indicators.description_it: Negli incontri ostili che coinvolgono chi sogna, quanto spesso è chi sogna a cominciare.
indicators.formula: dreamer as aggressor / (dreamer as aggressor + dreamer as victim); reciprocal, mutual, self-directed and witnessed aggressions excluded
indicators.notes: Domhoff (1996) computes the victimization percent (its complement) 'ignoring witnessed, reciprocated, mutual and self aggressions'. Mutual interactions are coded as reciprocal in the app and excluded.

indicators.description_en: The share of hostile acts that are physical, such as chasing, attacking or destroying property, rather than words or feelings.
indicators.description_it: La quota di atti ostili di tipo fisico, come inseguire, attaccare o distruggere oggetti, invece che parole o sentimenti.
indicators.formula: physical aggressions (levels A5 to A8) / all aggressions
indicators.notes: The coding rules class A1 to A4 as nonphysical and A5 to A8 as physical. All aggressions, witnessed included.

indicators.description_en: The number of hostile acts for each character in the dream.
indicators.description_it: Il numero di atti ostili per ogni personaggio del sogno.
indicators.formula: all aggressions / all characters
indicators.notes: Compared with 2.36 times the difference, not h (DreamSAT).

indicators.description_en: The number of friendly acts for each character in the dream.
indicators.description_it: Il numero di atti amichevoli per ogni personaggio del sogno.
indicators.formula: all friendly interactions / all characters
indicators.notes: Compared with 2.36 times the difference, not h (DreamSAT).

indicators.description_en: The number of sexual or romantic interactions for each character in the dream.
indicators.description_it: Il numero di interazioni sessuali o romantiche per ogni personaggio del sogno.
indicators.formula: all sexual interactions / all characters
indicators.notes: Compared with 2.36 times the difference, not h (DreamSAT).

indicators.description_en: Of the things that happen to the dreamer, good or bad, the share that are setbacks: being the target of hostility, mishaps and failed attempts.
indicators.description_it: Tra le cose che accadono a chi sogna, belle o brutte, la quota di imprevisti: essere bersaglio di ostilità, disavventure e tentativi non riusciti.
indicators.formula: (dreamer as victim + dreamer-involved misfortunes + dreamer-involved failures) / (dreamer as victim + dreamer-involved misfortunes + dreamer-involved failures + dreamer as befriended + dreamer-involved good fortunes + dreamer-involved successes)
indicators.notes: Not on the norms page table; value from Domhoff (2005) Table 3, formula from the norms explanation page. The app's coding holds every term. 'Dreamer as victim' and 'dreamer as befriended' are counted as in the aggressor and befriender percents (reciprocal, mutual and self-directed excluded); the explanation page does not state this, so it is the app's reading.

indicators.description_en: The share of mishaps that involve illness, injury or death.
indicators.description_it: La quota di disavventure che riguardano malattie, ferite o morte.
indicators.formula: bodily misfortunes (M5 injury or illness + M6 death) / all misfortunes
indicators.notes: Domhoff (1996, chapter 2): 'Bodily Misfortunes Percent = (M5 + M6) / all misfortunes'. The app's coding marks M5 and M6 with bodily: true. All misfortunes, witnessed included.

indicators.description_en: The share of named feelings that are anger, fear or worry, sadness or confusion, rather than happiness.
indicators.description_it: La quota di emozioni espresse che sono rabbia, paura o preoccupazione, tristezza o confusione, invece che felicità.
indicators.formula: (anger + apprehension + sadness + confusion) / all emotions
indicators.notes: Emotions of all characters. Domhoff (1996) gives 79 (men) and 82 (women) for emotions felt by the dreamer only.

indicators.description_en: When the dreamer makes a real effort toward a goal, the share of attempts that succeed.
indicators.description_it: Quando chi sogna si impegna davvero per un obiettivo, la quota di tentativi riusciti.
indicators.formula: dreamer-involved successes / (dreamer-involved successes + dreamer-involved failures)

indicators.description_en: Of all body parts mentioned, the share that are the torso, internal organs or sexual organs.
indicators.description_it: Tra tutte le parti del corpo citate, la quota che riguarda busto, organi interni o organi sessuali.
indicators.formula: (torso + anatomy + sex body parts) / all body parts
indicators.notes: The app's object class body_torso holds the published torso (BT), anatomy (BA) and sex (BS) subclasses; body_other holds head (BH) and extremities (BE).

indicators.description_en: Of the settings that are clearly indoors or outdoors, the share that are indoors.
indicators.description_it: Tra le ambientazioni chiaramente al chiuso o all'aperto, la quota al chiuso.
indicators.formula: indoor settings / (indoor + outdoor settings); ambiguous and no setting excluded
indicators.notes: Checked against the settings norms frequencies (https://dreams.ucsc.edu/Norms/settings.html): men 284 / (284 + 302) = 48%, women 362 / (362 + 229) = 61%.

indicators.description_en: Of the settings that are clearly known or unknown to the dreamer, the share that are known.
indicators.description_it: Tra le ambientazioni chiaramente note o sconosciute a chi sogna, la quota di quelle note.
indicators.formula: familiar settings / (familiar + unfamiliar settings); distorted, geographical and questionable excluded
indicators.notes: Which codes enter the formula is inferred from the settings norms frequencies, which reproduce the published values only with familiar (F) over familiar plus unfamiliar (U): men 197 / (197 + 123) = 62%, women 241 / (241 + 65) = 79%.
